case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You are working with tight capacity, so what matters is where your seals go. Option A gives Ravensteiner a binding volume over a long contract term, which is the planning security a full order book calls for.

Option A is the package we can approve: it commits us to the full volume for the whole term, and the claims below show why the price belongs where we have placed it.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, here is a short paragraph it can approve as it stands. Option A secures a binding volume with Ravensteiner for the full contract term, so your capacity planning rests on a firm commitment from a reliable customer, with a clear lead time to schedule against. Please take Option A to the committee on that basis.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We meet the agreed quality targets. Your cost estimate and quality records have been noted and permit a minor adjustment. 

We accept the volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term. Our offer stands at a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit. In exchange for this price and the extended contract, the lead time must remain at 54 days due to our high capacity utilisation.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for setting out both variants so clearly. You asked us to decide, and we have: we accept your alternative proposal, the one that keeps the longer lead time because of your capacity utilisation.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.70; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.

This gives Ravensteiner the full binding volume over the extended contract term, which is the planning security you are looking for. We take your lead time as the basis and will plan our call-offs around it.

If you confirm this as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Should your pricing committee or management need a short summary, this is it: Option A secures the full volume for the whole term with a reliable partner, at the price from your own alternative proposal. Please take it to them as it stands.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
